meta.title: M-1: action conditioning roughly doubles the usable prediction window
meta.source: M-1, world-model rollout error in the decision space of Sec. 3, LIBERO and DROID
meta.kill_threshold: error reduction at k=5 below 30% => pre-registered failure (currently 46.6%)
meta.notes: tauflip = 0.35 is the policy-flip threshold measured in fig:m3(b); it is the SAME number there, and the safe band, the horizontal rule and the y tick label are all drawn from it here. The two crossing markers (windowuncond, windowcond) are where each curve leaves the safe band -- if you replace the curves, recompute the crossings rather than editing them.
